config.state: Photograph of a construction or industrial site. Judge only visible physical conditions. Safety equipment (guardrails, harnesses, hard hats, vests, barriers) and normal tools in safe use are NOT violations.

questions.Fall_Hazard: Is a worker exposed to falling into an unguarded trench/opening or from an elevated edge, roof, ladder, or scaffold that lacks guardrails or a tied-off harness?
questions.f_fall_edge: Is there an unprotected elevated edge, incomplete scaffold, or unsafe ladder with a worker at risk of falling?
questions.f_fall_opening: Is there an unbarricaded floor opening, roof opening, deep trench, or steep excavation edge that someone could fall into?
questions.ok_fall_protected: Are all elevated edges and openings protected by intact guardrails, barriers, or tied-off fall-arrest harnesses (or are there no elevated edges or trenches)?
questions.Electrocution_Hazard: Is there an unprotected electrical hazard, such as damaged or exposed live wiring, makeshift power hookups, or work dangerously close to overhead power lines?
questions.f_elec_wire: Are exposed, hanging, frayed, or makeshift electrical wires, cables, or open junction boxes left unprotected in the work area?
questions.f_elec_lines: Are workers, ladders, scaffolds, or cranes operating dangerously close to overhead energized power lines?
questions.ok_elec_testing: Is the only visible electrical equipment a panel being actively inspected or tested by a technician wearing protective gear (gloves, helmet, or face shield)?
questions.PPE_Violation: Is a visible construction worker missing a required hard hat, high-visibility vest, eye protection, or task-specific protective gear (excluding fall harnesses)?
questions.f_worker: Is at least one person or worker visible in the image?
questions.f_ppe_nohat: Is a visible worker in a construction zone not wearing a hard hat or helmet?
questions.f_ppe_novest: Is a visible worker in a construction zone not wearing a high-visibility vest or reflective jacket?
questions.f_ppe_noeye_glove: Is a visible worker operating a power tool, welding, cutting, or handling hazardous materials without eye/face protection or gloves?
questions.Housekeeping_Storage: Is there a slip, trip, or housekeeping violation, such as debris scattered on floors, cords/materials blocking walkways, wet/muddy walking surfaces, or unstable stacked materials?
questions.f_house_trip: Slip and Trip Hazard: are cords, hoses, pipes, tools, or loose materials obstructing a walking surface, stair, or passageway?
questions.f_house_debris: Housekeeping and Storage: is scrap, trash, rubble, or unstable/leaning stacked material scattered disorganized across the work area?
